cd "$PWD" && ./venv/bin/python -c "
import os
from google.cloud import bigquery
proj=os.environ['GCP_PROJECT']; ds=os.environ['GCP_BQ_DATASET']
bq=bigquery.Client(project=proj)
tid=f'\`{proj}.{ds}.prediction_log\`'
sql=f'''
SELECT DATE(ts) d, COUNT(*) n, ROUND(AVG(prediction),4) mean, ROUND(STDDEV(prediction),4) sd,
  ROUND(MIN(prediction),3) mn, ROUND(MAX(prediction),3) mx
FROM {tid} GROUP BY d ORDER BY d'''
rows=list(bq.query(sql).result())
print('days:', len(rows))
for r in rows:
    print(r.d, r.n, r.mean, r.sd, r.mn, r.mx)
"

cd "$PWD" && ./venv/bin/python -c "
import os
from google.cloud import bigquery
proj=os.environ['GCP_PROJECT']; ds=os.environ['GCP_BQ_DATASET']
bq=bigquery.Client(project=proj)
tid=f'\`{proj}.{ds}.prediction_log\`'
# For each candidate onset date, split into before/after and compute Welch t-statistic magnitude
sql=f'''
WITH days AS (SELECT DISTINCT DATE(ts) d FROM {tid}),
scan AS (
  SELECT c.d AS onset,
    (SELECT AVG(prediction) FROM {tid} WHERE DATE(ts) < c.d) mb,
    (SELECT AVG(prediction) FROM {tid} WHERE DATE(ts) >= c.d) ma,
    (SELECT VAR_SAMP(prediction) FROM {tid} WHERE DATE(ts) < c.d) vb,
    (SELECT VAR_SAMP(prediction) FROM {tid} WHERE DATE(ts) >= c.d) va,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {tid} WHERE DATE(ts) < c.d) nb,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {tid} WHERE DATE(ts) >= c.d) na
  FROM days c )
SELECT onset, ROUND(mb,4) mb, ROUND(ma,4) ma,
  ROUND(ABS(ma-mb)/SQRT(vb/nb + va/na),1) tstat
FROM scan WHERE nb>0 AND na>0
ORDER BY tstat DESC LIMIT 5'''
for r in bq.query(sql).result():
    print('onset',r.onset,'meanBefore',r.mb,'meanAfter',r.ma,'|t|',r.tstat)
"

cd "$PWD" && ./venv/bin/python -c "
import os
from google.cloud import bigquery
proj=os.environ['GCP_PROJECT']; ds=os.environ['GCP_BQ_DATASET']
bq=bigquery.Client(project=proj)
tid=f'\`{proj}.{ds}.prediction_log\`'
sql=f'''
WITH days AS (SELECT DISTINCT DATE(ts) d FROM {tid}),
p AS (SELECT DATE(ts) pd, prediction FROM {tid}),
scan AS (
  SELECT c.d AS onset,
    AVG(IF(p.pd < c.d, p.prediction, NULL)) mb,
    AVG(IF(p.pd >= c.d, p.prediction, NULL)) ma,
    VAR_SAMP(IF(p.pd < c.d, p.prediction, NULL)) vb,
    VAR_SAMP(IF(p.pd >= c.d, p.prediction, NULL)) va,
    COUNTIF(p.pd < c.d) nb,
    COUNTIF(p.pd >= c.d) na
  FROM days c CROSS JOIN p GROUP BY c.d )
SELECT onset, ROUND(mb,4) mb, ROUND(ma,4) ma, nb, na,
  ROUND(ABS(ma-mb)/SQRT(vb/nb + va/na),1) tstat
FROM scan WHERE nb>0 AND na>0
ORDER BY tstat DESC LIMIT 5'''
for r in bq.query(sql).result():
    print('onset',r.onset,'meanBefore',r.mb,'meanAfter',r.ma,'nb',r.nb,'na',r.na,'|t|',r.tstat)
"
